title: Touch of Red counts additional attacks, not each attack
problem: Text: 'the damage of all their attacks is increased by 25% for each attack'. With the multi-hit fix (SU-0038) every hit gets +25% x the ADDITIONAL attacks (2 extra -> +50%); the text counts each attack (3 attacks -> +75%).
notes: Found while normalizing SU-0038. Fix: count total attacks (additional + 1) in Touch of Red's term. 2026-10-26 hook batch B2 built (research/hooks_B2.json, loader/hooks_B2.c). The (hits - 1) term at bc_CreatureAttack L1253 becomes hits when the chain has more than one attack (single attacks keep 0). Separate from SU-0038's per-hit pool reset; no shared bytes. In-game test: Touch of Red creature attacking 3 times in a row (e.g. with 2 extra attacks): each hit +75% (with SU-0038 on, every hit; base 320 -> 560 each). A single attack: no bonus.

release_notes.intended: When your creatures attack several times in a row, every attack gets 25% more damage for each attack.
release_notes.actual: In the unpatched game, only the additional attacks were counted (3 attacks gave +50%).
release_notes.fix: Now every attack counts, the first one included (3 attacks give +75%). Works with SU-0038.
